news.n_eur_vinland: Norse seafarers say that beyond Greenland, far to the west, they found a wooded land and called it Vinland.
news.n_eur_sepulchre: Pilgrims bring terrible news: the Caliph of Egypt has ordered the Church of the Holy Sepulchre in Jerusalem destroyed.
news.n_eur_sweyn: They say the Danish king Sweyn Forkbeard has conquered all England, and King Æthelred has fled to Normandy.
news.n_eur_cnut: After the death of Edmund Ironside the Dane Cnut has become King of England.
news.n_eur_bulgaria: Merchants from Constantinople say Emperor Basil has conquered Bulgaria and blinded Bulgarian captives by the thousand.
news.n_eur_orleans: At Orléans, by the will of King Robert, canons accused of heresy have been burned. Such a thing was never done before.
news.n_eur_conrad: Emperor Conrad has been crowned in Rome. Even Cnut, king of the English and the Danes, attended.
news.n_eur_cordoba: They say the great caliphate of Córdoba has broken up into dozens of small Muslim kingdoms.
news.n_eur_william_duke: Duke Robert of Normandy has died on pilgrimage, leaving as heir the boy William, whom men call the Bastard.
news.n_eur_truce_god: The bishops have proclaimed the Truce of God: from Wednesday evening until Monday morning no fighting, on pain of excommunication.
news.n_eur_edward: Edward, son of Æthelred, who grew up in Normandy, has become King of England. They say he is very pious.
news.n_eur_sutri: There were three popes in Rome at once. Emperor Henry called a synod at Sutri and deposed all three.
news.n_eur_leo9: The new Pope Leo is travelling the lands and deposing bishops who bought their sees.
news.n_eur_schism1054: Papal legates laid a bull of excommunication against the patriarch on the altar of Hagia Sophia. The Greeks answered in kind.
news.n_eur_henry1_fr: King Henry has died. His eight-year-old son Philip has ascended the throne of France.
news.n_eur_sicily: The Norman knights of the Hauteville family have crossed to Sicily to take the island from the Saracens.
news.n_eur_comet1066: In spring a long-haired star stood in the sky, and everyone wondered which king's doom it foretold.
news.n_eur_hastings: Duke William of Normandy has crossed the sea, slain the English king Harold and made himself king.
news.n_eur_manzikert: Merchants from the East say the Seljuk Turks have crushed the Greek emperor at Manzikert and taken him prisoner.
news.n_eur_cologne1074: The citizens of Cologne rose against Archbishop Anno and nearly killed him. He fled the city, then took cruel revenge.
news.n_eur_canossa: Emperor Henry stood barefoot in the snow for three days at the gates of Canossa until the Pope lifted his excommunication.
news.n_eur_rome1084: Robert Guiscard's Normans came to rescue Pope Gregory – and sacked and burned half of Rome.
news.n_eur_toledo1085: King Alfonso of Castile has taken the great city of Toledo, the ancient capital of the Visigoths.
news.n_eur_domesday: King William has had all England surveyed: every ox, every mill. People call the book the Domesday Book.
news.n_eur_sagrajas: The Almoravids have come over from Africa and defeated Alfonso of Castile at Sagrajas.
news.n_eur_bologna: They say that in Bologna teachers of Roman law are gathering students from all over Europe.
news.n_eur_cid: The Castilian exile Rodrigo Díaz, whom the Moors call El Cid, has taken Valencia.
news.n_eur_clermont: At Clermont Pope Urban called on all Christians to free Jerusalem. The crowds shouted: "God wills it!"
news.n_eur_citeaux: A few monks have left a rich abbey for the marshy wilderness of Cîteaux, to live by the Rule of Benedict without indulgence.
news.n_eur_jerusalem1099: News has come: the crusaders have taken Jerusalem. They say the streets ran ankle-deep in blood.
news.n_eur_rufus: The English king William Rufus has been found in the New Forest with an arrow in his chest. His brother Henry is king now.
news.n_eur_louis6: King Philip has died. His son Louis, called the Fat, is King of France.
news.n_eur_laon: The townsfolk of Laon, whose commune had been taken away, rose up and killed their bishop.
news.n_eur_clairvaux: A young monk named Bernard has founded an abbey at Clairvaux. Tales of his strictness and eloquence are spreading everywhere.
news.n_eur_abelard: Paris gossips about Master Abelard and his pupil Héloïse. The girl's family took cruel revenge on the teacher.
news.n_eur_templars: In Jerusalem a few knights have taken monastic vows to guard the pilgrim roads. They are called Templars.
news.n_eur_white_ship: The White Ship has sunk off Normandy. The English king's only legitimate son is drowned.
news.n_eur_worms: At Worms the Pope and the Emperor have finally come to terms over appointing bishops.
news.n_eur_bruges: Count Charles the Good of Flanders has been murdered in church at Bruges while he prayed.
news.n_eur_roger: The Norman Roger has been crowned King of Sicily. Greeks, Arabs and Latins serve at his court.
news.n_eur_anarchy: King Henry of England has died. His nephew Stephen has seized the crown, though the barons swore to Henry's daughter Matilda.
news.n_eur_eleanor: Young Eleanor, heiress of Aquitaine, has married Louis, heir to the French throne.
news.n_eur_matilda_london: The Londoners drove Empress Matilda out of the city just as she sat down to dine.
news.n_eur_edessa: News from the East: the emir Zengi has taken Edessa, the first of the crusader states.
news.n_eur_lisbon: English and Flemish crusaders on their way to the Holy Land helped the Portuguese take Lisbon.
news.n_eur_eleanor_henry: Louis has divorced Eleanor, and two months later she married Henry of Anjou – bringing him half of France.
news.n_eur_henry2: Henry of Anjou has become King of England. His lands stretch from Scotland to the Pyrenees.
news.n_eur_barbarossa: Frederick Barbarossa has been crowned emperor in Rome.
news.n_eur_milan: Emperor Frederick has taken Milan and ordered the city razed to the ground.
news.n_eur_magi: Archbishop Rainald has brought the relics of the Three Kings from Milan to Cologne.
news.n_eur_becket: The English king's knights have murdered Archbishop Thomas Becket in his own cathedral.
news.n_eur_legnano: The militias of the Lombard cities have defeated Emperor Frederick's knights at Legnano.
news.n_eur_hildegard: Abbess Hildegard of Bingen, who wrote of visions, herbs and music, has died in her convent on the Rhine.
news.n_eur_philip2: Fifteen-year-old Philip has become King of France. They say he is cunning beyond his years.
news.n_eur_hattin: Sultan Saladin has crushed the crusader army at Hattin and taken Jerusalem.
news.n_eur_barbarossa_dies: News has come: Emperor Frederick drowned crossing a river in Cilicia.
news.n_eur_richard_captive: King Richard the Lionheart has been seized by the Duke of Austria on his way home from the Holy Land. A huge ransom is demanded.
news.n_eur_alarcos: The Almohads have defeated the Castilian army at Alarcos.
news.n_eur_richard_dies: Richard the Lionheart has died of a crossbow wound at the siege of Châlus.
news.n_eur_normandy: King Philip has taken Normandy from King John of England.
news.n_eur_constantinople1204: Instead of Jerusalem the crusaders went to Constantinople, took it and sacked it.
news.n_eur_interdict: The Pope has laid England under interdict: churches are closed, bells are silent, the dead are buried without rites.
news.n_eur_francis: They say a cloth merchant's son from Assisi has renounced his inheritance and preaches poverty. The Pope has approved his brotherhood.
news.n_eur_children: People tell of crowds of children and poor folk walking to the sea, believing it will part before them all the way to Jerusalem.
news.n_eur_las_navas: The kings of Spain have routed the Almohads at Las Navas de Tolosa.
news.n_eur_bouvines: King Philip has beaten Emperor Otto and his allies at Bouvines. Parisians celebrated the victory for a week.
news.n_eur_magna_carta: The English barons have forced King John to seal a charter of liberties.
news.n_eur_lateran: A great council in Rome has decreed that every Christian must confess once a year and that Jews must wear a distinguishing sign.
news.n_eur_dominic: The Pope has approved the Order of Preachers founded by the Spaniard Dominic.
news.n_eur_damietta: The crusaders have taken Damietta in Egypt. They say Brother Francis went to the sultan himself to preach.
news.n_eur_prester_john: Rumours come from the East that King David, a descendant of Prester John, is smashing the Saracens and coming to aid the Christians.
news.n_eur_mongols_kalka: Merchants from Novgorod tell of an unknown people from the east who crushed the Russian princes on the river Kalka.
news.n_eur_louis9: Twelve-year-old Louis has become King of France. His mother, the Castilian princess Blanche, rules for him.
news.n_eur_frederick_jerusalem: The excommunicated Emperor Frederick has won Jerusalem not by the sword but by treaty with the sultan.
news.n_eur_paris_strike: After a brawl between students and the watch the masters of Paris went on strike and left the city. Learned Paris stood empty for two years.
news.n_eur_inquisition: Pope Gregory has charged the Dominican friars with seeking out heretics. They are called inquisitors.
news.n_eur_cordoba1236: King Ferdinand has taken Córdoba. The bells of Santiago, carried off long ago by the Moors, are being returned north.
news.n_eur_legnica: The Tatars have defeated Polish and German knights at Legnica and ravaged Hungary. They say they reached the Adriatic.
news.n_eur_talmud: In Paris twenty-four cartloads of Jewish books have been burned in the square.
news.n_eur_montsegur: The fortress of Montségur, the last stronghold of the Cathars, has fallen. More than two hundred of the "perfect" went to the stake.
news.n_eur_sainte_chapelle: In Paris the Sainte-Chapelle has been consecrated – a chapel of stained glass built for Christ's crown of thorns.
news.n_eur_louis_captive: News has come: King Louis has been captured by the Egyptians. The queen is gathering his ransom.
news.n_eur_florin: Florence is minting a gold coin – the florin. Soon it will be used from London to Acre.
news.n_eur_sorbonne: The royal chaplain Robert de Sorbon has opened a college in Paris for poor students of theology.
news.n_eur_baghdad: They say the Tatars have taken Baghdad and killed the caliph. The Saracens are in terror.
news.n_eur_byzantium1261: The Greeks have retaken Constantinople. The Latin Empire is no more.
news.n_eur_lewes: Simon de Montfort has defeated King Henry at Lewes and taken him prisoner.
news.n_eur_benevento: Charles of Anjou, the French king's brother, has defeated Manfred at Benevento and become King of Sicily.
news.n_eur_tunis: King Louis has died of a pestilence before Tunis, on his second crusade.
news.n_eur_polo: The Venetian Polos have set out again for the ends of the earth, to the great khan's court, taking young Marco with them.
news.n_eur_aquinas: The great theologian Thomas Aquinas has died on his way to the council.
news.n_eur_condemnation: The Bishop of Paris has condemned two hundred and nineteen propositions taught in the faculty of arts.
news.n_eur_vespers: In Palermo during vespers the people massacred the French. Sicily has given itself to the King of Aragon.
news.n_eur_wales: King Edward has conquered Wales and is building huge stone castles there.
news.n_eur_spectacles: They say a craftsman in Pisa has made "eyes for old men" from glass: two discs in a frame that make letters clear again.
news.n_eur_worringen: The people of Cologne have defeated their archbishop at Worringen.
news.n_eur_acre: Acre has fallen, the last great Christian fortress in the Holy Land.
news.n_eur_celestine: The aged hermit who became Pope has given up the throne of his own will after five months.
news.n_eur_polo_back: Marco Polo has returned to Venice after twenty-four years among the Tatars. He tells incredible things.
news.n_eur_stirling: The Scot Wallace has beaten the English at Stirling Bridge.
news.n_eur_jubilee: The Pope has proclaimed a Jubilee: whoever visits Rome receives full pardon. There are so many pilgrims that the bridge has two lanes of traffic.
news.n_eur_dante_exile: Florence has exiled the poet Dante Alighieri along with other "White" Guelfs.
news.n_eur_courtrai: Flemish townsmen have defeated French knights at Courtrai and gathered hundreds of golden spurs from the field.
news.n_eur_anagni: The French king's men burst into Anagni and insulted the aged Pope Boniface. A month later he was dead.
news.n_eur_avignon: The new French Pope has settled at Avignon. They say he is in no hurry to go to Rome.
news.n_eur_templars_end: At the Council of Vienne the Pope has abolished the Order of the Templars, arrested five years ago by the King of France.
news.n_eur_molay: On an island in the Seine the Grand Master of the Templars, Jacques de Molay, has been burned.
news.n_eur_bannockburn: Robert the Bruce's Scots have routed the English army at Bannockburn.
news.n_eur_shepherds: Crowds of "Shepherds" are marching south, calling themselves crusaders and attacking Jewish communities on the way.
news.n_eur_dante_dies: Dante has died at Ravenna without ever returning home. They say he visited Hell, Purgatory and Paradise – in verse, at least.
news.n_eur_mansa_musa: Genoese merchants tell of the black king of Mali who passed through Cairo with so much gold that its price there fell.
news.n_eur_cannon: They say the Florentine commune has ordered iron balls and brass tubes that hurl them with thunder and fire.
news.n_eur_valois: The last son of Philip the Fair has died. His cousin Philip of Valois has become King of France.
news.n_eur_sluys: The English have destroyed the French fleet at Sluys.
news.n_eur_crecy: English archers have cut down the French knights at Crécy.
news.n_eur_messina: Genoese galleys from the Black Sea have put in at Messina, their oarsmen dying of an unknown disease.
news.n_eur_calais: After a year's siege Calais has surrendered to the English king.
news.n_eur_jubilee1350: A new Jubilee year in Rome. After the plague pilgrims come to pray for mercy on the living.
news.n_eur_decameron: In Florence people are reading Messer Boccaccio's Decameron: a hundred merry tales told by young people fleeing the plague.
news.n_eur_poitiers: At Poitiers the English have captured King John of France himself.
news.n_eur_golden_bull: Emperor Charles has issued the Golden Bull: from now on seven princes elect the emperor, the Archbishop of Cologne among them.
news.n_eur_bretigny: Peace has been made at Brétigny: the English king renounces the French crown but receives a third of France.
news.n_eur_charles5: Charles, soon to be called the Wise, has become King of France. He is collecting books in the Louvre palace.
news.n_eur_najera: The Black Prince has defeated Henry of Trastámara's army at Nájera in Castile.
news.n_eur_montiel: At Montiel Henry of Trastámara killed his brother King Peter with his own hands and became King of Castile.
news.n_eur_limoges: The Black Prince has taken Limoges and slaughtered its townsfolk.
news.n_eur_petrarch: The poet Petrarch, who sang of his Laura, has died.
news.n_eur_papacy_rome: Persuaded by Catherine of Siena, Pope Gregory has left Avignon and returned to Rome.
news.n_eur_wyclif: In England the teaching of the Oxford master Wyclif, who put Scripture into English and disputes with the Pope, has been condemned.
news.n_eur_aljubarrota: The Portuguese, with English archers, have defeated the Castilians at Aljubarrota.
news.n_eur_cologne_uni: A university has opened in Cologne – the city's own, paid for by the council.
news.n_eur_kosovo: The Serbs have fought the Turks on the Field of Blackbirds. Both the Serbian prince and the Turkish sultan were killed.
news.n_eur_mad_king: They say the King of France lost his mind in a forest near Le Mans and attacked his own men with his sword.
news.n_eur_nicopolis: A crusading army of French and Burgundian knights has been crushed by the Turks at Nicopolis.
news.n_eur_richard2: Henry of Lancaster has deposed King Richard and taken the crown himself.
news.n_eur_ankara: Timur the Lame of Samarkand has defeated the Turkish sultan at Ankara and taken him prisoner.
news.n_eur_orleans_murder: The Duke of Orléans, the king's brother, has been murdered at night in Paris. The killers were sent by the Duke of Burgundy.
news.n_eur_grunwald: The Poles and Lithuanians have defeated the Teutonic Order at Grunwald.
news.n_eur_hus: At the Council of Constance the Czech preacher Jan Hus has been burned, though he was promised a safe-conduct.
news.n_eur_agincourt: At Agincourt King Henry of England has destroyed the French army.
news.n_eur_martin5: The Council of Constance has elected Pope Martin. The schism is over: there is one pope again.
news.n_eur_burgundians_paris: The Burgundians have burst into Paris and massacred the Armagnacs in the streets.
news.n_eur_troyes: By the Treaty of Troyes King Henry of England has been declared heir to the French throne.
news.n_eur_two_kings: Both kings have died: Henry of England and mad Charles of France. A one-year-old baby has been proclaimed king of both realms.
news.n_eur_orleans_siege: The English have laid siege to Orléans. If the city falls, the Dauphin will have nothing left.
news.n_eur_joan_burned: At Rouen the English have burned the Maid whom the French called Joan.
news.n_eur_bojador: Portuguese sailors have rounded Cape Bojador, beyond which the sea was believed to boil.
news.n_eur_paris_retaken: King Charles's troops have entered Paris. The English have left the capital.
news.n_eur_council_florence: In Florence the Greek emperor and patriarch have signed a union with Rome. There are so many Greeks in the city that their speech is heard in the streets.
news.n_eur_varna: A crusading army has been destroyed by the Turks at Varna. The young king of Poland and Hungary was killed.
news.n_eur_gutenberg: They say that in Mainz the goldsmith Gutenberg is printing books with metal letters.
news.n_eur_cade: Jack Cade has entered London with rebels from Kent. A few days later he was killed.
news.n_eur_constantinople1453: Terrible news has come: the Turkish sultan Mehmed has taken Constantinople. The last Greek emperor died on the walls.
news.n_eur_castillon: At Castillon French cannon have shattered the English. Of all France, the English crown keeps only Calais.
news.n_eur_comet1456: A long-haired star is in the sky again, and the Hungarian Hunyadi has held Belgrade against the Turks. The Pope has ordered the bells rung at noon.
news.n_eur_towton: In a snowstorm at Towton the Yorkists routed the Lancastrians. Edward of York is king.
news.n_eur_louis11: Louis, whom men call the Universal Spider for his cunning, has become King of France.
news.n_eur_charles_bold: Charles the Bold, the richest prince in the West, has become Duke of Burgundy.
news.n_eur_isabella: Princess Isabella of Castile has secretly married Ferdinand of Aragon.
news.n_eur_neuss: Charles the Bold besieged Neuss for almost a year, but the imperial army forced him to withdraw.
news.n_eur_cologne_free: The Emperor has recognised Cologne as a Free Imperial City.
news.n_eur_nancy: Charles the Bold has been killed before Nancy. His body was found in the ice only two days later.
news.n_eur_inquisition_spain: The Pope has allowed the Catholic Monarchs to set up their own inquisition for the "New Christians".
news.n_eur_pazzi: In Florence an attempt was made to murder the Medici brothers in the cathedral.
news.n_eur_otranto: The Turks have landed in Italy and taken Otranto.
news.n_eur_princes: King Richard has taken the throne, and his young nephews have vanished in the Tower.
news.n_eur_bosworth: King Richard has fallen at Bosworth. Henry Tudor is king.
news.n_eur_dias: The Portuguese Dias has rounded the southern tip of Africa. The sea road to India is all but open.
news.n_eur_granada: The Catholic Monarchs have taken Granada, the last Muslim city in Spain.
news.n_eur_columbus: The Genoese Columbus has come back across the ocean and says he sailed to islands off the coast of the Indies.
news.n_eur_tordesillas: Spain and Portugal have divided the unknown lands across the ocean by a line drawn on a map.
news.n_eur_charles8: The French king Charles has crossed the Alps with a huge army and cannon and is marching on Naples.
news.n_eur_cabot: The navigator Cabot, in an English ship, has reached a new land in the west, where the cod are so thick they are scooped up in baskets.
news.n_eur_savonarola_burned: In Florence the friar Savonarola has been hanged and burned.
news.n_eur_gama: The Portuguese Vasco da Gama has returned from India by sea, with pepper and cinnamon.
news.n_eur_cabral: A Portuguese fleet on its way to India has stumbled on a huge land in the west.
news.n_eur_st_peters: In Rome a new basilica of Saint Peter has been begun. Money for it is raised by indulgences from all over Europe.
news.n_eur_luther: They say a Saxon monk named Luther has posted theses against indulgences. They are already being printed all over Germany.
news.n_eur_cluny: They say the abbey of Cluny has grown so great that hundreds of monasteries from Spain to England answer to it.
news.n_eur_westminster: King Edward has consecrated the new stone abbey church at Westminster – the largest in England.
news.n_eur_gregory7: Pope Gregory has excommunicated Emperor Henry a second time, and Henry has set up a pope of his own.
news.n_eur_tinchebray: King Henry of England has defeated his brother Robert at Tinchebray and taken Normandy for himself.
news.n_eur_schism1159: The cardinals have elected two popes: one recognised by the emperor, the other by the kings of France and England.
news.n_eur_oxford_scholars: English scholars sent home from Paris are gathering to study at Oxford.
news.n_eur_constance1183: At Constance Emperor Frederick has recognised the liberties of the Lombard cities.
news.n_eur_albert: The Dominican Albert, called the Great, teacher of Thomas Aquinas, has died in Cologne. They say he knew everything, from stones to stars.
news.n_eur_templar_arrest: On Friday the thirteenth of October King Philip's men arrested every Templar in France in a single day.
news.n_eur_famine: Across the north there has been famine for three years: the rains rotted the grain, and they say people are eating bark.
news.n_eur_arno: In Florence the Arno has swept away nearly all the bridges. The city is in mourning.
news.n_eur_war1337: King Edward of England has claimed the French crown. War has begun.
news.n_eur_bardi: The Florentine banks of the Bardi and Peruzzi have failed: the English king did not repay them.
news.n_eur_jacquerie: In France the peasants have risen and are burning castles. They are called the "Jacques".
news.n_eur_peasants1381: In England rebellious peasants have taken London and killed the archbishop.
news.n_eur_ciompi: In Florence the wool carders have seized the Palace of the Signoria.
news.n_eur_joan_orleans: They say a peasant girl in armour has raised the siege of Orléans.
news.n_eur_medici_return: The banker Cosimo de' Medici has returned to Florence in triumph.
news.n_eur_formigny: At Formigny the French have beaten the English and recovered Normandy.
news.n_eur_bible42: At the Frankfurt fair they showed a Bible printed at Mainz: even lines, not a single mistake.
news.n_eur_toro: At Toro the armies of Isabella and Ferdinand have secured the Castilian throne.
